summary: Organigram Global Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release that provides a business update covering the initial performance of its recent acquisition of Sanity Group GmbH (closed April 15, 2026) and Canadian market share data. No new special-situation event is announced; the filing is a routine operational update with no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no structural changes. The press release reports that Sanity has maintained ~10% market share in Germany and that Organigram holds 11.1% Canadian recreational cannabis share. There is no tender, strategic review, restructuring, or other special-situation event in this filing.
